tools.name: Shopify
pros: Ready to use out of the box, no local install or maintenance
Free tier available, try before you upgrade
cons: Advanced features and higher limits usually require a paid plan
usage:
Step: Open the official site and sign up
Click the red "Visit official site" button to open the Shopify homepage. Find "Sign Up" and log in with email or Google/GitHub.
Tip:
If the site won’t load, check your connection or try another browser.

Step: Pick the plan that fits you
New users usually get a free trial or free quota. Start with the Free tier before upgrading.
Check:
After sign-up you should see the Dashboard home.

Step: Create your first task / project
Click "New" or "Create New" and follow the guide. Pick the first template to start.
Tip:
Don’t start with a complex request. Test with one simple sentence, e.g. "Summarize this page into 3 points".

Step: Review and save the result
When done, the tool shows the result. Export, copy the link, or save locally.
Check:
If unhappy, click "Regenerate" or tweak the prompt and try again.
tools.detail: Shopify is a comprehensive e-commerce platform designed for online stores. It offers a user-friendly interface that allows businesses to easily create, customize, and manage their online storefronts. Key features include a wide range of customizable themes, integrated payment solutions, and robust analytics tools. Shopify is suitable for small to large businesses looking to establish a strong online presence. It also offers advanced features like abandoned cart recovery, multi-channel selling, and a mobile app for on-the-go management. Pros include ease of use, scalability, and a strong support network. Limitations may include transaction fees for certain payment gateways and the need for additional apps for more complex functionalities.
